visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Missing Call to the Superclass Constructor
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The program does not compile: the Manager constructor never calls the constructor of Employee.

solution.explanation: Every constructor starts by calling a superclass constructor. When none is written, Java inserts super() with no arguments, but Employee has no such constructor, so the code does not compile. Call super(name, salary) explicitly as the first statement.
